paragraphs: Huna Mar bar Marimar, Bava Metzia 81a. Yehuda bar Marimar, Berakhot 45b.[^1][^2]

notes.text: פא.. and מה:. give Bava Metzia 81a and Berakhot 45b under the period/colon convention with terminal punctuation, without independent named-edition verification. Older machine יהורה and omitted colon differ from supplied יהודה and מה:.
The heading collects patronymic attestations without establishing a single father. Huna Mar order remains; Mar is the explicit separate title, whereas Marimar is a name. No title is added to Yehuda.
